sections.text_helper: Section 78.12 "Trace and debug subsystem" in chapter 78 (Debug support (DBG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 4494.
sections.section_content:
The trace and debug subsystem includes the following CoreSight components:
• trace subsystem ROM table
• global trace timestamp generator (TSGEN)
• system cross-trigger interface (CTI)
• cross-trigger matrix (CTM)
• trace port interface unit (TPIU)
• trace bus funnel (CSTF)
• embedded trace FIFO (ETF)
• embedded trace router (ETR)
• replicator
• system trace macrocell (STM)
• serial-wire output (SWO)
The MCU ROM table in the Cortex-M55 subsystem pointed to by the BASE register in the
Cortex-M55 AHB-AP links to the trace subsystem ROM table. This secondary ROM table
contains the base address pointer for the CoreSight trace components.
These components are accessible by the debugger and the Cortex-M55 processor via the
system AHB-AP and its associated EPPB debug bus.
